info.name: Stedi Healthcare Claims Claim acknowledgments Partnerships API

params.name: partnershipId
params.description: A unique ID for this partnership within Stedi. You can find this ID on the [Trading partners](https://www.stedi.com/app/core/partnerships) page under **Partnership identifier**.

params.name: transactionGroupId
params.description: A unique ID for a transaction group stored on Stedi. You can only call this endpoint with a given `transactionGroupId` once. Afterward, the transaction group is locked.

items.docs: This endpoint generates and delivers a fully-formed EDI file containing the staged transactions in the specified transaction group.

params.name: partnershipId
params.description: A unique ID for this partnership within Stedi. You can find this ID on the [Trading partners](https://www.stedi.com/app/core/partnerships) page under **Partnership identifier**.

params.name: transactionSettingId
params.description: A unique ID for the outbound transaction setting Stedi should use to determine the correct guide for validation and generation. It must be attached to the partnership associated with the `partnershipId`. To find the `transactionSettingsId`, go to the partnership and use the **Transaction Setting ID** field for the outbound transaction setting.

params.name: transactionGroupId
params.description: A unique ID for a group of transactions on Stedi. Stedi creates a new transaction group if one does not exist with the specified ID.

items.docs: This endpoint stages a transaction for outbound delivery.

params.name: partnershipId
params.description: A unique ID for this partnership within Stedi. You can find this ID on the [Trading partners](https://www.stedi.com/app/core/partnerships) page under **Partnership identifier**.

params.name: transactionSettingId
params.description: A unique ID for the outbound transaction setting Stedi should use to determine the correct guide for validation and generation. It must be attached to the partnership associated with the `partnershipId`. To find the `transactionSettingsId`, go to the partnership and use the **Transaction Setting ID** field for the outbound transaction setting. If you are generating a transaction with fragments, the associated guide must be configured to use fragments.

items.docs: This endpoint generates and delivers fully-formed EDI files containing a single transaction. It is the simplest way to generate EDI with Stedi.
